== Formal definition ==

Let $(F,+_F,\cdot_F,>_F) be an [[field (mathematical concept)#Ordered_field|ordered field]]. Let $\ge_F$ denote $>_F \lor =$.

$M\in F$ is an '''upper bound''' of set $A \subseteq F$ if

$$
M \ge_F a,\, \forall a \in A;
$$

a '''lower bound''' of set $A \subseteq F$ if

$$
a \ge_F M,\, \forall a \in A
$$
